Nadine: hey folks, quick onboarding Q  trying to annotate a Grafana panel with deploy events but I can't find where deploy events come from. Grafana 'annotations' panel is empty. who owns the source?
Carlos: welcome Nadine! :wave: the deploy annotations are emitted from Datadog as events (we call the stream 'deploy-events'). Are you looking at the model-serving dashboard?
Nadine: yes model-serving (uid: z9k-model-rt). I see an 'annotations' row but nothing shows for the last week.
onboard-bot: Hi Nadine! Remember to fill out the Observability access form so you get Datadog/Sentry/Grafana roles: https://go/redwood/obs-access
Carlos: two possibilities: 1) Grafana is configured to pull events from Datadog via the datadog datasource and your Grafana account needs the "events:read" mapping, or 2) the deployment pipeline isn't emitting the event tags we filter on.
Devon: tagging eng-observability @Carlos  I can check the pipeline. Nadine, can you tell us what annotation filter is set (panel > annotations)? usually we filter on source:deploy and tags:service:model-serving.
Nadine: panel filter is "source = deploy AND tags:service = model-serving". pipeline is our CI (github actions -> infra deploy job).
Carlos: ok if filter is that strict and the CI isn't tagging events there's nothing to show. You can search Datadog events directly: Datadog -> Events -> search 'service:model-serving source:deploy' to see raw events.
Nadine: I tried that and Datadog returns events but the grafana panel still empty. is there a mapping step?
Devon: Grafana uses the Datadog API key of the grafana-service-account to query events. If you're missing the 'events:read' role in Datadog or Grafana can't reach Datadog because of a network policy, you'll see nothing. Carlos, do we have a recent change to the datadog datasource?
Carlos: not recently. Nadine, can you paste a sample event id you saw in Datadog (e.g., dd-event-12345)? we'll trace it.
adine: found one: dd-event-31277, message: "deploy model-serving v1.12 -> prod".
Carlos: thanks. I checked the grafana backend logs and found an API 403 when Grafana tried to query Datadog for that event id. That means the grafana-service-account API key in our secret store rotated and wasn't updated in Grafana. I'll file an infra task but can also temporarily add a Grafana annotation manually.
Devon: FYI for Sentry we also annotate crashes as events (sentry->datadog pipeline). If you need Sentry project access to search errors, the obs-access form will get you 'project:reader'.
Nadine: thanks. is there a way for me to test annotations locally?
Carlos: you can post a Datadog event with a tag and see if Grafana picks it up. example curl (use your Datadog staging api key):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/events" \
 -H "DD-API-KEY: <staging-key>" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"title":"test deploy","text":"deploy tag test","tags":["service:model-serving","source:deploy"]}'
```
Nadine: I posted a staging event and I can see it in Datadog but still nothing in Grafana (staging grafana?).
Carlos: ah, Grafana queries production datadog datasource by default. We have a staging Grafana workspace but it's separate. If you want to test annotations in staging, ping me and I'll point you to staging grafana and a staging datasource.
Nadine: ok I want to verify the pipeline tags. can someone confirm if our github action sets tags on deployment events?
Devon: yep the deploy job emits a Datadog event via an action step. I just checked the workflow and we include tags: service:model-serving, env:prod, source:deploy. So pipeline looks fine.
Carlos: made a quick fix to rotate the grafana-service-account key in Grafana to the updated secret. Should be live in ~2m.
Nadine: refresh shows annotations now!! I can see my staging test and the last three deploys, perfect. thank you both.
Devon: awesome. I filed a small follow-up to standardize the annotation filters across dashboards so this mismatch doesn't happen again.
Nadine: last Q: I still can't see Sentry project in the Sentry UI. the obs-access ticket is #10234. is that ok?
Carlos: that ticket covers Sentry. We grant Sentry 'project:reader' after identity mapping. If it's been >24h, ping here and I'll nudge oncall infra.
Nadine: perfect, thanks. really appreciate the fast help :raised_hands:
thread_text_short: New hire Nadine can't see Grafana deploy annotations; Carlos and Devon trace it to rotated Grafana Datadog API key and datasource/env mismatch; fix applied and annotations appear.
